confidence_basis: Main PDF, OpenDataLoader output, fallback pypdf extraction, rendered methods pages, Springer HTML, local DOCX supplement, extracted supplement text, and cited-protocol lineage to Canzoneri 2012 and Finisguerra 2015 were reviewed. The PPS task reports the lateral seven-speaker trajectory, white-noise stimulus, speed, tactile timing-distance mapping, baseline/catch rows, counts, manual ITI policy, and pre/post structure. Remaining uncertainty is mainly exact audio file, gain calibration, switching law, and response timeout.

profile_recreation_assessment.reason: The PPS task can be recreated as a lateral left-of-head seven-speaker looming white-noise profile with neck vibration and pre/post training sessions. It is not a frontal trajectory: the speaker line is on the participant's left side, and the echolocation training object is a separate front/head-level task.

source_checks.scope: Reviewed methods, apparatus figure, PPS task, training/control tasks, procedure, analysis baseline, counts, and discussion for Segment 1-4 values.
Used as primary extraction map for methods, speaker geometry, trial rows, and count fields, then checked against fallback text and page images.
Searched all pages for white noise, speaker, tactile, distance, delay, catch, unimodal, baseline, randomized, inter-trial, response, echolocation, and control-task terms.
Temporary rendered pages were visually checked to verify the lateral left-of-head speaker line, distance labels, moving-sound arrow, tactile placement, trial counts, and manual ITI note.
Supplement and extracted text were checked for additional Segment 1-4 details; it adds raw-RT analyses but no missing stimulus-generation or count parameters.
Springer HTML and reference list were checked for article status, methods context, and cited protocol lineage to Canzoneri 2012 and Finisguerra 2015.

review_attempts.result: Captured the PPS task methods, seven-speaker apparatus, white-noise motion, trial families, baseline correction, and per-session count fields.
Confirmed the distance values, 3 s duration, 34 cm/s speed, 12-per-distance count, 28 unimodal trials, 28 catch trials, and experimenter-started ITI.
Verified that the PPS speaker array is lateral to the participant's left side and approaches the head/neck, while the separate echolocation training object is frontal.
Checked the DOCX supplement and extracted text; no hidden scripts, stimulus files, SPL/gain law, response timeout, or alternate counts were present.
Separated seven distance-defined audio-tactile timings from pre/post unimodal tactile baselines and auditory-only catch trials.
Checked cited prior-protocol context from Canzoneri 2012 and Finisguerra 2015; Tonelli supplies its own lateral seven-position PPS implementation details.

stimulus_type.value: Task-irrelevant looming auditory stimuli were white noise.
stimulus_type.evidence_note: The PPS task identifies the acoustic stimulus class as white noise.

source_provenance.value: White noise was delivered through a custom seven-loudspeaker array controlled by custom Matlab code; exact file, seed, or source script is not supplied.
source_provenance.evidence_note: Apparatus and software provenance are reported, but not a reusable audio asset.

trajectory_count.value: One lateral approaching trajectory toward the participant's left side/head, sampled at seven speaker distances.
trajectory_count.page_or_section: PDF p.3, Fig. 1 and PPS task
trajectory_count.evidence_note: Figure and methods show one left-side approach trajectory.

trajectory_path.value: Seven loudspeakers on a table to the participant's left at head elevation; sound approached from 119 cm to 17 cm from the head/neck in 17 cm steps.
trajectory_path.page_or_section: PDF p.3, Fig. 1 and PPS task
trajectory_path.evidence_note: Rendered Fig. 1 confirms the path is lateral left-of-head, not frontal.

stimulus_duration.value: The moving sound covered the speaker array in 3 s.
stimulus_duration.evidence_note: Duration is reported directly with the path length and speed.

stimulus_speed.value: Sound moved along 102 cm in 3 s, corresponding to 34 cm/s.
stimulus_speed.evidence_note: Speed, duration, and path length are directly reported.

auditory_conditions.value: PPS trials included looming white-noise audio-tactile trials, auditory-only catch trials, and no-sound tactile baseline trials.
auditory_conditions.evidence_note: The task rows define the auditory and no-audio conditions.

gain_envelope.evidence_note: No SPL, gain, cross-fade, speaker-switch law, or calibration curve was found after main PDF, rendered-page, fallback, supplement, and source-route checks.

renderer_or_apparatus.value: Custom device with seven serially connected loudspeakers, custom Matlab code, an 18 mm2 neck vibration motor, and microphone voice-response capture.
renderer_or_apparatus.evidence_note: The apparatus elements and control/recording path are reported.

trial_rows_families.value: Three PPS trial families: audio-tactile target trials, unimodal tactile-only trials, and auditory-only catch trials.
trial_rows_families.evidence_note: The three rows are listed with percentages and counts.

condition_intermixing.value: Audio-tactile, unimodal tactile, and catch trials were randomized within the PPS experimental block.
condition_intermixing.evidence_note: The paper states trial types were randomized in the experimental block.

blocked_or_random_order.value: All participants completed PPS pre-test, group-specific ECHO/TIME/REST intervention, and PPS post-test; group assignment for TIME/REST was pseudo-random.
blocked_or_random_order.evidence_note: PPS sessions bracket the intervention; this is a pre/post design.

iti_jitter_policy.value: Inter-trial interval was not fixed because each trial was started by the experimenter.
iti_jitter_policy.evidence_note: The ITI policy is explicit, but no numeric distribution is provided.

response_window.evidence_note: Participants responded as fast as possible by saying TAH, but no numeric timeout or scoring response window was found.

task_sequence_rules.value: Participants were blindfolded, ignored the sound, said TAH quickly to neck vibration, and withheld responses during auditory-only catch trials.
task_sequence_rules.evidence_note: Task instructions and catch response rule are reported.

tactile_stimulus.value: A custom vibration motor with 18 mm2 surface delivered 20 ms vibrotactile stimulation on the left side of the participant's neck.
tactile_stimulus.evidence_note: Tactile device size, duration, and body site are reported.

soa_table.value: Tactile timings corresponded to seven sound positions at 17, 34, 51, 68, 85, 102, and 119 cm; 17 cm spacing at 34 cm/s implies 500 ms timing steps over the 3 s sound.
soa_table.page_or_section: PDF pp.3-4, Fig. 1 and PPS task
soa_table.evidence_note: Distance positions are reported; onset-indexed timing is derived from reported spacing, speed, and duration.

baseline_strategy.value: Unimodal tactile-only trials without auditory stimulation were used as baseline correction; the fastest pre/post unimodal RT average was subtracted from bimodal RTs.
baseline_strategy.page_or_section: PDF pp.4-5, PPS task and RT processing
baseline_strategy.evidence_note: The baseline correction rule is described in the task/analysis sections.

baseline_timing.value: Unimodal tactile trials occurred at two delays: 500 ms before sound onset and 500 ms after sound offset.
baseline_timing.evidence_note: Baseline timing values are directly reported.

catch_trial_type.value: Catch trials presented the auditory stimulus only and no tactile stimulus; participants were expected not to respond.
catch_trial_type.evidence_note: Catch trials were included to reduce automatic/expected responses.

repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.value: Each PPS session had 12 trials for each audio-tactile sound-position/tactile-delay combination across seven distances, giving 84 audio-tactile trials.
repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.evidence_note: The paper reports 12 repetitions for each audio-tactile combination.

baseline_count.value: Each PPS session had 28 unimodal tactile-only trials.
baseline_count.evidence_note: Unimodal tactile count is directly reported.

catch_count.value: Each PPS session had 28 auditory-only catch trials.

block_count.value: The PPS task was administered twice, once before and once after the ECHO/TIME/REST intervention; each session contained one randomized experimental block.
block_count.page_or_section: PDF p.4, PPS task and Procedure
block_count.evidence_note: Pre/post PPS structure and within-session block organization are reported.

total_trial_count.value: Each PPS session had 140 trials: 84 audio-tactile, 28 tactile-only baseline, and 28 auditory-only catch; pre/post PPS implies 280 PPS trials.
total_trial_count.evidence_note: Total count and component counts are directly reported.

critical_caveats: Exact white-noise file, random seed, or reusable stimulus-generation script is not supplied.
No SPL, gain, speaker-switch, or cross-fade law is reported for the seven-speaker movement.
No numeric PPS response timeout/scoring window is reported.
ITI is manual and unfixed; no numeric ITI distribution is available.
The SOA table is distance-defined; onset-indexed millisecond values are derived from reported speed and 17 cm spacing.
The PPS trajectory is lateral left-of-head/neck, while the echolocation training object is a separate frontal/head-level task.
next_manual_action: Use this as a high-confidence lateral head-centered PPS/echolocation profile. Lab recreation still needs explicit defaults for the audio asset, gain/switch law, ITI realization, and response timeout.
